title: .asd writer for the current DAW version (only if M0 says go)
description:
## Intent
Write `.asd` files. **Only if M0's decision is go**; otherwise close as not needed (the reviewer does) and M2 uses the `.alc` carrier.

## Scope
- `asd::write(&WarpMap, audio: &Path) -> Vec<u8>` for the current DAW version, filling whatever ties the file to its audio (size, time, checksum) as §Formats found.
- Round-trip scenarios tagged `@asd-write` turn green.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw` all green including `@asd-write`. Manual: put a written `.asd` beside a fresh copy of `steady-120.wav`, drag the WAV into the DAW: it lands on the grid with the markers Apricity wrote (record the DAW version).

Commit: `feat(<this id>): write .asd warp markers`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
